scope: The spherical vector coefficient of one split multiplicity-one rank-one standard intertwining integral; not the full operator on all K-types.

rank_one_model.haar_measure: Lebesgue dx in the declared rank-one noncompact chart

literature_context.reference: A.W. Knapp and E.M. Stein, Intertwining Operators for Semisimple Groups II, Invent. Math. 60 (1980), 9-84
literature_context.use: theorem context for meromorphic standard intertwiners; the displayed spherical coefficient is rederived directly

independent_controls.chart: x=tan(theta), so the integrand times dx is cos(theta)^(z-1) dtheta
independent_controls.method: independent composite Simpson quadrature on theta in [-pi/2,pi/2]

claim_ceiling: The split multiplicity-one rank-one standard integral has the displayed beta/gamma coefficient on its spherical vector. This does not construct or certify the operator on the remaining compact-picture K-types.
